metadata.case_name: LEE KAM LIN v. FULL WISE LIMITED trading as FISHING BAY RESTAURANT

plaintiff.occupation_before: assistant in the dim sum take away counter
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: sedentary job such as car park attendant, security guard or cashier

injuries.description: right knee contusion with meniscus tear; grade 3 tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus
source: Dr Kong agreed the plaintiff had right knee contusion with meniscus tear.
Not until 20 July 2014, the plaintiff’s MRI scan revealed the plaintiff was suffering from grade 3 tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

injuries.description: major depressive disorder arising from stressor of residual pain and long term consequence arising from her physical symptoms
source: For reason of the persisted pain, the plaintiff was depressed and developed suicidal idea. Her psychiatric symptoms surfaced in or about February 2013.
Dr Kwan opined that plaintiff was suffering from major depressive disorder of which the stressor was the residual pain and long term consequence arising from her physical symptoms.

manifestations.description: tenderness and bruising without fracture over her right knee
reduced range of motion of her right knee
social functioning was impaired; she was considered to be unfit to perform some daily living activities and housework
negative thoughts on her future and a sense of worthlessness

treatments_received: Accident and Emergency attendances at Caritas Medical Centre on 7, 9, 12 February 2012, 26 March 2012 and 17 April 2012
physiotherapy sessions with Caritas from 8 June 2012 until 11 July 2012
attended the Department of Orthopaedics & Traumatology in Caritas from 28 September 2012
treatments_future: arthroscopic meniscus repair or meniscectomy (Dr Kong suggested)
pharmacological and psychological intervention (Dr Kwan suggested)
adjustment of pharmacological treatment by clinical psychologist (Dr Kwan suggested)

losses.description: reduced range of motion of her right knee and residual pain causing difficulty when walking up the slope

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: considered to be unfit to perform some daily living activities and housework
reduced competitiveness and is handicapped in the labour market; difficulty to resume her previous job

For reason of the persisted pain, the plaintiff was depressed and developed suicidal idea. Her psychiatric symptoms surfaced in or about February 2013. Dr Kwan opined that plaintiff was suffering from major depressive disorder of which the stressor was the residual pain and long term consequence arising from her physical symptoms.
